integrity: Analytic arguments provided for unbounded parameter ranges; finite exact-algebra checks are supporting diagnostics only. Published ingredients are credited, and the independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp finite-step positivity threshold only for unweighted P4, matched filter p=c=1; other graphs and p/c configurations only one-way eventual negativity from a pseudoinverse sign. Results concern completed exact-arithmetic updates of linear symmetric heat flows, not nonlinear dynamics, internal-stage positivity or cost of implementation. Historical priority awaits independent expert checking.
title: Sharp four-vertex positivity frontier for a symmetrically filtered heat step
